home.heroLine2: I work in environments where reliability matters. My background is rooted in IT infrastructure and managed services, with over 6 years of experience in Hyper-V-based Windows server environments, Microsoft 365, networking, and security.
home.heroLine3: Alongside infrastructure, I also build web applications with modern JavaScript frameworks and continue to grow in automation and Infrastructure as Code with Terraform.
home.tagline1: Systems fail — it’s an unavoidable part of the job.
home.tagline2: My responsibility is to prevent what can be prevented and control what cannot.

body.p1: My name is Lazar Vujović, I am 32 years old, and I come from  Serbia, where I currently live and work. I spent a part of my life in Vienna, where I also studied Computer Science at the Technical University. I did not finish my studies, but that experience meant a lot to me, both professionally and personally, especially because I improved my German there and became familiar with that kind of work culture and business communication.
body.p2: At the moment, I work for the German company ITM, where my main focus is the administration and maintenance of Hyper-V Windows server infrastructure. This includes working with Windows servers such as file servers, terminal servers, and similar systems, as well as administering firewall solutions such as Lancom and Sophos, Veeam backup and recovery systems, and IP telephony.
body.p3: In addition to that, I also manage Microsoft 365 environments, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive. Alongside the infrastructure side of the job, I am also involved on a daily basis in resolving more complex incidents and communicating directly with business users, mainly in German.
body.p4: Besides my regular job, I also work independently on web application development. I mainly work in the JavaScript ecosystem, using technologies such as React, Vue, and Next.js, and I usually implement Docker-based Linux environments myself, using Hetzner or AWS. Recently, I have also become very interested in Terraform and Infrastructure as Code, because I want to further expand my knowledge in the direction of automation and modern infrastructure management.
